meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: Subject to the authority of the State Board under Section 2-205 (e) of this article, each county superintendent shall explain the true intent and meaning of: (i) The school law; and (ii) The applicable bylaws of the State Board. Subject to the provisions of Section 6-203 and Subtitle 4 of Title 6 of this article and without charge to the parties concerned, each county superintendent shall decide all controversies and disputes that involve; (i) The rules and regulars of the county board; and (ii) The proper administration of the county public school system. In this section, the references to “Baltimore City” have been deleted as unnecessary in light of the deﬁnition of “county” in §1-101 of this article. An. Code 1957, art. 77, § 160; 1978, ch 22 § 2; ch. 713, § 2; 1983, ch. 630; 1984, ch. 255.
